name: Code input
summary: Six boxes for a verification code that move to the next box as you type and fill all at once when you paste, with a resend countdown and a wrong-code error.
use: for a one-time sign-in or verification code
a11y: The boxes are a labelled group, each input says which digit it is and points to the message, arrows and Backspace move between boxes, the first box offers one-time-code autofill, and the message is a polite live region.
